d: Congress MP Imran Masood has sparked a political controversy with his remark, “Whether it is Diwali or pollution, it is a human-made disease.” While discussing rising air pollution, Masood mentioned Diwali in the same context, triggering sharp criticism from the BJP. Uttar Pradesh BJP President Pankaj Chaudhary accused Congress of disrespecting Sanatan Dharma. The Samajwadi Party distanced itself from the remark, calling it Masood’s personal opinion.
